assignment_rule: Assign to the profile with the lowest mean Gower distance to its frozen reference members.
validation_design: 500 repeated stratified five-fold cross-validation runs with one out-of-fold prediction per respondent per repeat.
why_this_design: The tested respondent and all other members of the held-out fold are excluded from the four profile means, preventing self-contribution and testing sensitivity to the reference cohort.

gower_logic.father_edu: ordered difference / 6; unknown or refused pairwise unavailable
gower_logic.mother_edu: ordered difference / 6; unknown or refused pairwise unavailable
gower_logic.worked_while_studying: binary exact match or mismatch; missing pairwise unavailable

tie_rule: lowest profile ID for exact equal mean-distance minima; ties recorded
confirmation_rule: SAFE TO FREEZE if at least 95% of complete repeats jointly pass all five SAFE thresholds.
